articles.summary: TheRas, Inc. d/b/a BridgeBio Oncology Therapeutics (“BBOT” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on RAS-pathway malignancies, today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted Fast Track designation to BBO-8520, an investigational oral therapy for the treatment of adult patients with previously treated, KRASG12C-mutated metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
articles.title: BridgeBio Oncology Therapeutics (BBOT) Granted U.S. FDA Fast Track Designation for BBO-8520 for KRASG12C-Mutated Metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
